design: INDIVIDUAL 16: a tall mature elder of many campaigns, heavy scarred shoulders, weathered ash-grey hide with cream mottling, broad face and long tapered rear skull. Numerous silver tendrils fall to chest in three thick grouped locks. A long dark teal robe under a short purple geometric mantle, one large flat bronze rank plate across sternum and wrapped forearms. Carries a closed slim scroll cylinder at his side and braces the other palm against a bronze walking staff with a rounded disc top. Calm civic posture.
